#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create a one-hour team meeting event for next Wednesday at 3 PM local time."""
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone


def format_with_offset(dt):
    """Format datetime as iCalendar local time with UTC offset, e.g. 20250129T150000-0500."""
    off = dt.utcoffset()
    total = int(off.total_seconds())
    sign = "+" if total >= 0 else "-"
    total = abs(total)
    hh = total // 3600
    mm = (total % 3600) // 60
    return dt.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S") + f"{sign}{hh:02d}{mm:02d}"


def main():
    now = datetime.now().astimezone()
    today = now.date()

    # Next Wednesday: Monday=0 ... Wednesday=2. If today is Wednesday, go to next week.
    delta = (2 - today.weekday()) % 7
    if delta == 0:
        delta = 7
    meeting_date = today + timedelta(days=delta)

    start_local = datetime(
        meeting_date.year, meeting_date.month, meeting_date.day,
        15, 0, 0, tzinfo=now.tzinfo,
    )
    end_local = start_local + timedelta(hours=1)
    dtstamp_utc = now.astimezone(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
    uid = f"{uuid.uuid4()}@example.com"

    lines = [
        "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
        "VERSION:2.0",
        "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN",
        "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
        "BEGIN:VEVENT",
        f"UID:{uid}",
        f"DTSTAMP:{dtstamp_utc}",
        f"DTSTART:{format_with_offset(start_local)}",
        f"DTEND:{format_with_offset(end_local)}",
        "SUMMARY:Team Meeting",
        "DESCRIPTION:Weekly team meeting",
        "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
        "TRANSP:OPAQUE",
        "SEQUENCE:0",
        "BEGIN:VALARM",
        "ACTION:DISPLAY",
        "DESCRIPTION:Team Meeting starting soon",
        f"TRIGGER:-PT15M",
        "END:VALARM",
        "END:VEVENT",
        "END:VCALENDAR",
    ]

    ics_content = "\r\n".join(lines) + "\r\n"

    with open("team_meeting.ics", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
        f.write(ics_content)

    print(f"Event created in team_meeting.ics")
    print(f"Date (next Wednesday): {meeting_date} ({meeting_date.strftime('%A')})")
    print(f"Start: {start_local.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z')} ({start_local.tzname()})")
    print(f"End:   {end_local.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z')} ({end_local.tzname()})")
    print(f"Duration: 1 hour")
    print(f"Summary: Team Meeting")
    print(f"Reminder: 15 minutes before")
    print("--- ICS content ---")
    print(ics_content)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
